<details>
The PKGBUILD defines sources for both x86_64 and aarch64 architectures, fetching an AppImage binary, an icon, and a desktop file from trusted upstream or maintainer-controlled GitHub repositories. The URLs use HTTPS and point to official or clearly attributed sources: the main project's GitHub repository (`op7418/CodePilot`) and the maintainer's own `Cleboost/missing-aur` repository. The `sha256sums` are provided and not set to 'SKIP', meaning the integrity of the downloads will be verified after fetching.

During the `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare` and `makepkg --printsrcinfo` commands, only the global scope and `pkgver()` (not present here) are evaluated. There is no command substitution, no execution of external code during sourcing, and no network operations triggered outside of the declared `source` array (which is expected behavior). The `prepare()` and `package()` functions are not executed due to `--noprepare` and `--nobuild`. Therefore, simply sourcing this PKGBUILD and downloading the sources poses no risk of arbitrary code execution or data exfiltration.

The use of `::` in source URLs is standard for renaming downloaded files and does not introduce risk. All operations are consistent with safe AUR packaging practices.
</details>
